baseline.relation: Linked comparison baseline: the CH-final run of this horizon (MLflow 298c4718b4d64e6f8a5c315e8c22d25d; not refitted). Same inputs, CH-corrected labels and label kinds, cohort, scored rows, report families and aliases, histories, features, frozen quartet parameters, seed, per-row weights, contexts, cutoffs and identity calibration (the unfiltered no-fit build equals the CH-final self-consistency digests); only each backbone's fitting labels are restricted to the final label_kind == original rows, so memberships, fitting keys, fitting-row histories, schedule and fit ledger differ. model_card.architecture: Four independent XGBRegressor (reg:squarederror, CPU hist, seed 42, 16 threads, no early stopping); q3 and the shared q2/q4/q5 group each take n_estimators, learning_rate, max_depth, min_child_weight, subsample and colsample_bytree from the frozen winner of this horizon (values in the settings section as q3_* and other_*; search space n_estimators 100-600, learning_rate 0.02-0.20 log, max_depth 4-12, min_child_weight 0-32, subsample 0.5-1, colsample_bytree 0.4-1); reg_alpha 0, reg_lambda 1, gamma 0.1 (q3) / 0 (q2/q4/q5); unnormalized 24-month half-life weights per monthly row; no calibration by design (identity units, no core inputs); bounded decreasing projection; inclusive q_k >= 0.20 phase decoding.
model_card.evaluation: Selection is inherited (the tuned parameters were frozen by the original search; no new search). This refit: the CH-final run's annual expanding contexts and calendar; the whole inherited scored cohort (historical and 2026-01..10, originals and copies, unweighted) gives the standard six metrics (binary F1/F2/precision/recall, phase3plus R2, macro F1) for the pooled historical window, each historical year and 2026-01..10 (MLflow <scope>.<metric>, <scope>.n_rows) and the inherited report tables (six report regions x primary / 2026-01..10 holdout; all regions and the Somalia subset x 2023/2024/2025/holdout; report_tables.csv/.json, MLflow report.*). Paired original-label view against the CH-final run's retained predictions on exactly paired (context, admin_code, target_ord) keys with identical truths: for historical_2023/2024/2025 (declared windows respected; an empty window is NA with its reason), historical_pooled (recomputed from rows, never the 2026 holdout) and holdout_2026_01_10: original = this run on the CH-final run's label_kind == original rows; matched_augmented = the CH-final run on exactly those rows; augmented_total = the CH-final run on every inherited row; delta = matched_augmented - original (MLflow origin.<period>.<group>.<metric>, origin.<period>.<group>.n_rows, origin.<period>.delta_matched_augmented_minus_original.<metric>; origin_comparison.json/.csv, origin_tui.csv). Total versus matched is a population contrast, not an isolated model effect. region_mapping.csv is the frozen map of the inherited pairing only.

model_card.feature_engineering: Original-label fit ablation (task 10-30): label preparation, CH validity correction, features and reported-phase histories are exactly those of the CH-final run; validity copies are scored but excluded from the backbone fitting labels. Inherited description: CH validity correction (task 10-28, ch_links.csv.gz sha256 ac4ad6aaa8dc...): Eligible Cadre Harmonise raw labels are linked through their documented source route (legacy gdf_ch features with may25 current records; the dec25 2025 centroid join; the mars26 refresh lineage) to a current reference window; linked rows of the same source and destination country fill blank existing area-months of that window with copies (all new rows are copies; occupied and QC-invalid rows keep their values); the 150 May-2026 upstream copies become copies of their January report with one January history event per area (storage month May retained); cross-country, CAF, ambiguous and unresolved labels are preserved without expansion, and cross-country labels and events also carry their source-report family for exclusions. Copies take the reference-window start month as their nominal source and availability month. GPP_mean/GPP_std of the interim are replaced (task 10-27, corrected interim sha256 b2d5d2ce6bd6...; extraction sha256 11aa7f744c68...): zonal means of the official GOSIF-GPP v3 monthly Mean and SD rasters 2010-01..2025-12 over all 6,227 panel polygons, fill codes 65534/65535 masked before averaging, scale 0.01 (g C m-2 month-1), independent ArcGIS 10.8 cell-centre memberships on the source grid; a polygon-month without valid cells is NaN; 2026 GPP is blank (no source); no old-series value is retained. The 13 GPP_mean-derived columns (value, MA3/MA6/MA12, SD12, same-month z and its MA3/MA6/MA12, vegetation-stress share12/months_since/longest_run12/any12) are recomputed from it; GPP_std is not a model input. 527 inputs in this order: the frozen compact296 block without its 14 conflict columns (282, incl. the two national IDP columns), 128 AlphaEarth 2017 admin descriptors, the 114 aggregated-ACLED columns, then the three local-IDP columns idp_ipcch_ffill6_current, idp_ipcch_ffill6_ma3, idp_ipcch_ffill6_ma6 (x(O), mean x(O-2..O), mean x(O-5..O) of idp_ffill6, idp_ipcch_monthly.parquet sha256 8b2ba2998817...). The 14 compact296 conflict columns (event_count_violence and sum_fatalities_violence value/MA3/MA6/MA12/SD12 at O and the event nonzero-stress share12/months_since/longest_run12/any12) are removed; the raw old ACLED panel columns stay in the interim as provenance only. They are replaced by 114 columns of the 18 staged aggregated ACLED series acled_agg_{events,fatalities,exposure,exposure_share,spill_events,spill_fatalities}_{battles,erv,vac} of IPCCH_202610_interim_acledagg_gosifv3_20261027.csv (sha256 b2d5d2ce6bd6...; monthly aggregate sha256 539746f5f6bc...): for every series x(A), trailing means over A-2..A, A-5..A and A-11..A (at least 2/3/6 observed months) and the sample SD over A-11..A (ddof 1, at least 6 observed) (90 columns, names s__{value,ma3,ma6,ma12,sd12}_at_origin_lag1); for the six event series the persistence of the NaN-preserving signal x > 0: share12, longest_run12 and any12 over A-11..A (at least 6 observed months; a missing month breaks a run) and months_since (calendar months since the latest observed event, NaN before the first, advancing through missing months) (24 columns, s__nonzero_stress__{share12,months_since,longest_run12,any12}_at_origin_lag1). Every one of the 114 columns is evaluated at A = O - 1 = T - H - 1 for fitting rows, original scoring rows and validity copies (at their own recipient month); no ACLED value of month O or later enters a row. Missing ACLED values stay NaN (never zero). Every non-ACLED column keeps the production run's name, relative order and timing (built at O = T - H; history from original reported phases with the scoring context's report families removed, H0 bound T-1, else O); values equal the production run except the 13 GPP_mean-derived columns (GOSIF-v3 input) and the five reported-phase history columns, which are rebuilt from the CH-corrected report events and families. Inputs otherwise equal the 2026-10-19 refresh (WFP_Price and WFP_Price_std redefined as 100 + local-currency year-on-year %; WFP_Price__price_shock_stress keeps its yoy > 10% rule on that index; new World Bank RTP and Bloomberg vintages; IPC areas/analyses snapshot 2026-10-19). All transforms are recomputed in the job.
model_card.limitations: Versus the linked CH-final run (MLflow 298c4718b4d64e6f8a5c315e8c22d25d): only the backbone fitting-label membership differs (validity copies removed; the retained original rows keep their CH-final weights, which are not renormalized, so the total fitting weight is smaller); labels, cohort, scored rows, report families, aliases, histories, features, parameters, seed, contexts, cutoffs and identity calibration are identical (verified before fitting). Copy report families remain excluded from fitting labels and histories exactly as in the CH-final run. The original-only fits use fewer rows, so the comparison reflects both the absence of copy supervision and the smaller fitting sample. Final label_kind is the CH-final classification; unresolved and cross-country CH originals stay as in the CH-final run and CH copy-only source events are not promoted to original labels. One seed; descriptive point estimates and paired differences only (no bootstrap, interval or significance test). CH copies take the reference-window start month as their nominal source and availability month: a retrospective modeling convention, not a verified publication date, so this is not a strict real-time forecast; copies are not independent reports. Unresolved, current/projected-ambiguous, CAF and cross-country CH source routes are preserved without expansion; the retained CH source has no current window after 2026-05. Parameters were selected on the same historical years that are reported, so historical results after tuning are descriptive and optimistic, not an independent test; 2026-01..10 outcomes of the linked run were inspected before this task, so 2026 is not an untouched test either. The search is one provider-default (ALGORITHM_UNSPECIFIED) study of at most 40 trials per horizon; another search or seed can select other parameters. Tuned learner, one seed; no significance test or causal claim. ACLED features follow the staged aggregated export's definition (area-weighted ADM1 values; weekly totals split by days; exposure a lower-bound weekly maximum on a fixed WorldPop 2020 denominator; spillover from covered neighbours only). All exports share the 2026-10-20 retrospective vintage: historical publication dates and revisions are not verified, so this is not a demonstrated real-time forecast. Intentional ACLED missingness stays NaN: no values before country coverage, exposure/share blank before 2015-01, spillover blank without a covered neighbour, every 2026-10 cell blank; documented structural breaks (Somalia partner change, CAR reporting lag, Benin source loss, Afghanistan VAC gap, DRC gaps, Ecuador coding change) are not adjusted. Uncalibrated by design (no B2 or provider fits). Inherited inputs: local IDP is an assessed partial-area stock assumed available at report-month end; round-level validity linkage and observation-month availability are assumptions and copies are not independent reports; AlphaEarth 2017 is a retrospective static descriptor; weather-oracle rows can be incomplete (NaN kept); Bloomberg/WB/climate/IDP input gaps of the 2026-10-19 refresh remain; GPP has no 2026 source data (GOSIF-GPP v3 ends 2025-12) and polygon-months without valid source cells are NaN; 2026 targets never occur in the fitting labels and 2026-05..10 targets have incomplete inputs. Research tracking only; not accepted for production and not promoted over the linked ACLED run. Not promoted over the original tuned run. Not promoted over the GOSIF-v3 run. Not promoted over the CH-final run.

model_card.summary: Fixed-parameter refit of the CH-final run of validity_augmented_idp_202610_acledagg_lag1_uncal_hpt, lead 0 months (MLflow 298c4718b4d64e6f8a5c315e8c22d25d; gosif-v3-input-20261027+ch-validity-20261028), whose only change is the backbone fitting-label membership: each annual context keeps only the final CH-corrected label_kind == original rows of its CH-final fitting pool (h00_main_2023 19,169, h00_main_2024 24,197, h00_main_2025 28,551, h00_supp_2026 37,759); IPC and CH validity copies are removed from fitting labels only. The quartet parameters frozen for this horizon (winner search 37), seed, unnormalized 24-month half-life weights of the retained rows, features, reported-phase histories, report-family and alias exclusions (copy families included), contexts, cutoffs and identity calibration are reused without re-tuning; the full inherited cohort (originals and copies) is scored. Linked comparison baseline: the CH-final run (not refitted), paired on identical keys and truths.
model_card.target: cumulative phase shares q2-q5, q_k = sum(P_k..P5) / sum(P1..P5) from raw phase shares; QC: P1-P4 observed, a truly missing P5 = 0, every share finite in [0,1], exact total in [0.90,1.10], estimated_population ignored; phase = greatest k with q_k >= 0.20 (else 1); crisis = phase >= 3; evaluation rows include IPC validity copies (inherited: an existing IPC label copied to blank months of its analysis validity period) and Cadre Harmonise validity copies (new in this refit: an eligible current CH label copied to blank area-months of its reference window, source and destination in the same country), each counted once; fitting labels exclude every validity copy (final label_kind == original only), scoring keeps all rows
